title: Post-completion village texture is inconsistent: some places rewrite their room description precisely (the stone-cutter's lodge correctly shows 'the stone cut small, edge to edge' after the field's-stone choice; Reedholm shows 'nets finally mended' after the drowned nave rests) while others (the pensioner's banner-staff) do not, making it unclear which visible details are meant to be tracking state versus flavor.
